name: Kyousei Hatsujou Monogatari -J* Hen-
source:
On his 10,000th masturbation, a special power and a hint was oracled to him.

"If there is a person you like, or a person you want to have sex with,
try staring at her."

If you received such an oracle, would you try it?

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE166034.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
在迎来人生第10000次自慰的那一刻，一道神谕连同特殊异能一同降临到了他的身上：

“若是遇到心仪的女孩，或是想要与之交欢的对象，
不妨试着死死盯住她吧。”

倘若你收到了这样的神谕，你会忍不住试一试吗？

[摘自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE166034.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
